title: Game snapshot
description: The plain-data tree returned by Game.getSnapshot() (public/display/engine/Game.js). Fresh objects per call, JSON-serializable throughout, no live references into the engine. All positions/lengths are world units (VMAX = 9 units/s, lap ~350-480 units); all times are seconds of simulated race time. Coordinates are right-handed, +Y up (three.js convention). See docs/native-port/contract.md.

version.description: CONTRACT_VERSION stamp (public/display/engine/contract.js). Bump on any shape/unit change.

elapsed.description: Seconds of simulated race time. 0 at construction; advances only when the host calls update(dtMs). No consumer today; kept in the contract.

cars.description: One entry per live car. Order = car insertion order (the starting grid), NOT rank order. Forfeited (removed) cars are absent.

boxes.description: Index-aligned with the track's authored item-box list. true = box available (respawn cooldown expired).

id.description: Monotonically increasing banana id. Its own namespace (not car ids, not rocket ids).

s.description: Arclength position, wrapped to [0, track length) at drop time. World units.

lat.description: Signed lateral offset from the centerline; positive = right of travel. World units.

radius.description: Trigger radius, world units. Currently always the constant 0.5 (BANANA_RADIUS).

bananas.description: Dropped bananas currently live (elapsed >= liveAt). Renderers reconcile meshes by id.

id.description: Monotonically increasing rocket id. Its own namespace, and the id carried by the rocket_expire event.

s.description: Arclength position, wrapped to [0, track length) at snapshot time. World units.

lat.description: Signed lateral offset; positive = right of travel. World units.

owner.description: Firing car's id (per-cell FX gating). No consumer today; kept in the contract.

rockets.description: Live homing rockets. Facing/bank derive from the centerline tangent at s.

vec3.description: Plain {x, y, z} literal. Right-handed, +Y up, world units.

id.description: Car id: peerIndex (number) in live games; strings like 'cpu-bolt' for bots/tests/traces.

pos.description: World position (centerline point + lateral * lat, on the road surface).

forward.description: Unit facing vector (heading yaw + axle-chord pitch applied).

up.description: Unit local surface normal at the car's (s, lat).

pose.description: Plain-data copy of the car's world pose. No vector class, no live reference.

lat.description: Signed lateral offset from the centerline, world units; positive = right of travel. Clamped inside the local curbs (per-sample width / 2 - 0.3).

v.description: Raw speed, world units/s. Can exceed vmax while boosted/monster.

spd.description: v / vmax (per-car base top speed). EXCEEDS 1 under boost/monster: pad ceiling x1.60, item boost x1.5, monster x1.25, stacking to ~2.0.

lap.description: 1-based DISPLAY lap, clamped to [1, totalLaps]. Grid cars (totalS < 0) show 1.

position.description: Live race rank, 1..N. Finished cars first by finish time, then live race order.

of.description: Field size (number of live cars). No consumer today; kept in the contract.

finishTime.description: Seconds (= elapsed at the line crossing); null until finished.

steer.description: TURN-ALIGNED steer: sign matches the actual turn direction (STEER_SIGN x raw input), so renderers need not know the sign convention.

steerInput.description: RAW controller steer input (drives the on-screen steer bar). The steer/steerInput asymmetry is deliberate.

spin.description: Cosmetic spin-out whirl angle, radians, 0 to 4*pi (SPIN_TURNS = 2 whole turns); 0 when in control.

boostActive.description: boostMul > 1.001. No consumer today (renderers read boostMul); kept in the contract.

boostMul.description: Current speed-ceiling multiplier (pad max 1.60, item boost 1.5).

tCatch.description: Smoothed catch-up factor (0 = on the leader, 1 = adrift at the back). Scales item durations. Engine/tests only; kept in the contract.

monster.description: Currently transformed into the monster truck; renderer morphs the model.

totalS.description: CUMULATIVE arclength, world units. Negative on the starting grid (spawn behind the line); grows monotonically across laps, never wrapped.

heading.description: Car yaw relative to the track tangent, radians, clamped to +-1.25 (no u-turns).

halfLen.description: Collision half-length, world units; x1.3 while monster. Debug bbox overlay only.

halfWid.description: Collision half-width, world units; x1.3 while monster. Debug bbox overlay only.
